name: caveman-concierge
description: Pick-and-choose agent/skill store for the Caveman Concierge personal-orchestrator harness.

plugins.name: concierge-core
plugins.description: Session-continuity tracker (Project/Effort/Session, local SQLite) and a local token-usage report. The foundation plugin most other plugins here assume is present.

plugins.name: concierge-git
plugins.description: Git commit/branch/merge subagent with a mandatory pre-commit secret scan. Optionally manages a second repo (e.g. a notes vault) alongside the instance repo.

plugins.name: concierge-docs
plugins.description: Diagrams (D2) and document rendering (Pandoc) subagents — turns Markdown/notes into SVGs, PDFs, DOCX, etc.

plugins.name: concierge-memory-obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian vault subagent (notes, project plans, reading/shopping lists) backed by the Obsidian Local REST API plugin over MCP.

plugins.name: concierge-local-llm
plugins.description: Exposes a local Ollama model as an MCP tool for bounded, low-stakes text work — no network calls leave the machine.

plugins.name: concierge-google
plugins.description: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Tasks subagent via OAuth2.

plugins.name: concierge-finance
plugins.description: Tracks personal spending from Chase/BoA statement exports (CSV/OFX/QFX). Parses and categorizes transactions locally via Ollama into a SQLite store. Bank data never leaves the machine.

plugins.name: concierge-paperwork
plugins.description: Finds and suggests filing for personal documents synced from a cloud drive. Search-only — extracts/classifies via a local Ollama model, never Claude's API.

plugins.name: concierge-fantasy
plugins.description: Tracks Sleeper leagues and DraftKings NFL DFS. Local rosters/stats/optimization, weekly recommendations via local Ollama, VBD draft board, live draft-day pick signals. Read-only on DraftKings.

plugins.name: concierge-family
plugins.description: Tracks kids' school life: processes school email into a notes vault, calendar events, and Google Tasks. Ships a routing-config template, not real family data.

plugins.name: concierge-media
plugins.description: Manages a Plex media server and its acquisition stack (qBittorrent, Prowlarr, Radarr, Sonarr, Jellyseerr) over HTTP. Finds/downloads media, oversees automation, triages family requests against an approval policy.
